lines: You get an AI assistant running on your own computer inside chats you already use.
It is open software for your devices, meeting you in chats like Discord or Slack.
It runs on your devices right now in Discord or Slack chats by using a local Gateway that connects directly to everything you already have.
Run this command to start onboarding and check its status immediately.
Configure your AI models and plug in new skills through the dedicated Tools section.
The installer works on macOS, Linux, Windows, and WSL2.
It is MIT licensed and built by an independent nonprofit called OpenClaw Foundation.
Start by running openclaw onboard with --install-daemon.
Send this to someone who needs an AI on their own computer.
Meet the lobster way with openclaw.
